title: Training health (Spa-adapted) — stage1
subtitle: D6's own checks, generalised from the single synthetic corner to Spa's tightest corner where two checks depend on it.

checks.name: policy_is_actually_updating
checks.detail: median approximate KL per update is 0.00134 against a 0.0001 floor.

checks.name: exploration_matches_the_action_scale
checks.detail: [ADAPTED from D6: uses Spa's tightest corner, r=11.4 m, not the synthetic track's single corner] holding it needs a normalised steering action of about 0.130; the policy searches with a standard deviation of 0.082, a ratio of 0.6x.
checks.group: Is the search at the scale of the problem?

checks.name: the_task_is_completable
checks.detail: [ADAPTED from D6: uses Spa's tightest corner, r=11.4 m, not the synthetic track's single corner] the car makes 10.1 m/s round it at the limit and starts episodes at 15.0 m/s.
checks.group: Is the task possible, and did it get solved?

checks.name: the_off_track_rate_came_down
checks.detail: episodes ending off the road went 0.52 -> 0.98. NOTE (Spa-specific, not in D6): with a multi-km lap and a policy nowhere near completing one, this rate is expected to stay near 1.0 regardless of safety improvement -- see the hazard metric (mean distance before crash) instead, computed downstream in the per-section eval, not here.
checks.group: Is the task possible, and did it get solved?

checks.name: the_critic_predicts_returns
checks.detail: explained variance over the last fifth of training has a median of +0.00. At zero the critic is no better than predicting the mean, which makes every advantage estimate noise and the policy gradient a random walk.

checks.name: the_deployed_policy_completes_the_task
checks.detail: the mean-action policy finishes 0% of laps and covers 388 m. Sampling instead gives 0% and 397 m. NOTE (Spa-specific): a full Spa lap is ~7,000 m from most starts -- this is expected to fail until stage 2 at the earliest and is not this run's gate.
checks.group: Does the policy you would actually deploy work?

checks.name: greedy_and_stochastic_agree
checks.detail: deployed distance 388 m vs sampled 397 m, a 2% gap.
checks.group: Does the policy you would actually deploy work?

checks.name: the_policy_stayed_inside_the_tire_model
checks.detail: deployed policy spends 2.6% of steps beyond the 12 deg envelope bound (occupancy 2.5%).
